title: AEO Program Governance and Recommendation Framework
summary: The evolution of AEO recommendations shifted from a general liaison group structure in 2018 to a highly formalized, multi-tiered institutional process by 2025. The framework now mandates specific reporting templates, clear separation between evaluation teams and the AEO Committee, and formal procedures for status upgrades and monitoring.

evolution.institutional_structure: From a simple committee to a multi-layered hierarchy involving the AEO Center, evaluation teams, and the NBR Committee.
evolution.procedural_formality: Transitioned from general advisory roles to mandatory, template-driven reporting (Appendices) for all recommendations.

timeline.change: Established the initial liaison group and AEO committee mandate for providing recommendations on certification and monitoring.
Introduced standardized reporting templates (Appendices) and a rigid workflow for recommendations involving the AEO Center, evaluation teams, and the NBR Committee.
Expanded the scope of the liaison group to include broader government and private sector representation.

Liaison Group: This group is formed to oversee the implementation of the Authorized Economic Operator program and is responsible for providing recommendations regarding operational actions to the relevant board member within a specified timeframe.
National Board of Revenue: The board is empowered, through its designated member, to set the scope of work and structure for the liaison group tasked with supporting customs programs.

Authorized Economic Operator: The committee is responsible for scrutinizing applications for Authorized Economic Operator status.

National Board of Revenue: The committee serves the National Board of Revenue by providing recommendations and submitting periodic monitoring reports concerning operator activities.
Monitoring Report: The committee is tasked with submitting quarterly reports to the relevant member of the National Board of Revenue regarding the operational performance and compliance of Authorized Economic Operators.
